name: desktop_sdk
_comment: Native desktop runner scaffolding, installed into the HOST repo (not lib/) - the installer supports arbitrary install targets, same as SDKs that install to android/, ios/ or assets/. Every install is app_type-gated: each host opts into exactly the desktop platforms it builds, keyed by its .rokct/config/app_type marker. App-name parameterization: the installer substitutes the literal ${package} token (the host composer.json's package_name) into text files at install time, and its substitution extension list includes .rc/.cpp/.h alongside .txt, so windows/CMakeLists.txt (project()/BINARY_NAME), windows/runner/Runner.rc (FileDescription/InternalName/OriginalFilename/ProductName) and windows/runner/main.cpp (window title) are all shared, fully ${package}-parameterized templates - no per-app copies anywhere under windows/. To adopt desktop_sdk in a new app: add an app_type block here installing templates/windows, and add desktop_sdk to that app's composer template.

pos._comment: pos keeps all three desktop platforms (it always had them via the old ungated top-level installs). macos/linux templates still carry pos-era admin_desktop naming and are not yet parameterized - follow-up when a second app adopts them.
